resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Conformity (Residential Resale Certificate / property maintenance certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Shamong Township Construction Office (Building Code, Construction Permits & Zoning)
resale_co.lead_time: Give 14 days notice when scheduling the inspection. By ordinance the inspection is done and a certificate or violation notice issued within 10 days of the application. Inspections are done Tuesdays and Thursdays, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
resale_co.valid_for: If the ownership change does not happen within six months, a new application is required
requirements: Smoke alarm on each floor, including the basement (not unfinished attic or crawl space)
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of all bedrooms
House numbers on the front of the house or end of the driveway, at least 3 inches, lighted or reflective
Reflective house numbers on both sides of the mailbox
Pool and hot tub enclosures up to code
Steps and railings stable and secure
Chimney caps and spark arrestor installed
Visible, mounted 2A10BC fire extinguisher in the kitchen (January 2024 form)
All construction permits closed before the inspection is completed

fees.label: Residential re-sale inspection
fees.quote: The fee for said inspection will be $50.00.

fees.label: Re-inspection
fees.quote: If a re-inspection is required an additional fee of $25.00 will be collected.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply online with the township's Residential Resale/Rental Certificate application (GovPilot, linked from the Building Code page) and pay by credit card, or use the Residential Re-Sale Inspection PDF with a check payable to Township of Shamong, mailed or brought to the Construction Office, 105 Willow Grove Road, Shamong, NJ 08088. Give 14 days notice when scheduling. Questions go to inspections@shamong.net or (609) 268-2377 x305.

resale_co.notes: Township Code Chapter 68 (Certificate of Conformity, read through the ecode360 print view) says no single-family home or unit that is sold or rented may be occupied by the buyer until a certificate of continued conformity is issued; inspection covers smoke and CO alarms, chimney spark arresters, house numbering, pool and hot tub enclosures, and steps and railings. Fees: $50 and $25 per reinspection (code, PDF form and online form agree). If the township does not inspect within 10 days, the code lets the home be occupied subject to later inspection. The township now links an online GovPilot 'Residential Resale/Rental Certificate' application (card payment) as well as the January 2024 PDF. Kevin Bagnell is the Construction Permit/Resale Inspector; Ed Toussaint (etoussaint@shamong.net) is the Construction Code/Zoning Official. The online form also lists a Rental Certificate ($50) and a Lead Safe Certificate ($295 plus $20 state fee), which apply to rentals, not to sales.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Shamong (LEA registry code S). The DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Shamong without the "SC" (smoke certs) flag, and the state directory names the Shamong Twp Construction Office, 105 Willow Grove Rd, (609) 268-2372, for smoke detector compliance. The directory phone (609) 268-2372 differs from the township office number 609-268-2377 used on the form and web page. The township page links the DCA "Smoke Alarm/Carbon Monixide Compliance" information sheet and says to call the Construction Office at 609-268-2377 x305 for specific requirements. The state removed the portable fire extinguisher from the sale certificate requirement in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19). The township's PDF form and online application still list it.

other_items.label: All construction permits closed
other_items.detail: All construction permits must be closed before the resale inspection can be completed.

other_items.label: Buyer purchasing "as is"
other_items.detail: If the buyer is purchasing the property as is, the township needs a notarized letter saying so; no certificate is issued without it.

open_questions: Is the kitchen extinguisher still required given P.L.2025, c.19? Both township forms still list it.
